name: storefront-suite-web
description: Front-end demo in React and TypeScript covering three retail workflows: Contacts, Point of Sale and Service Orders. Data is mocked in memory and persisted to localStorage, with dependency inversion so the mock layer could be swapped for real HTTP calls.

paragraphs: A fully working, front-end-only demo application built to showcase architecture, code organization and UI engineering skills. It reproduces three common retail workflows (Contacts, Point of Sale (POS) and Service Orders), with all data mocked in memory and persisted to localStorage, so it runs standalone with no backend required.
This project is a portfolio piece: it is not connected to, and does not depend on, any production system.
features: Contacts: create, edit, list and delete customer records.
Point of Sale: build a cart from a mocked product catalog, optionally attach a
customer, and check out (with stock validation).
Sales History: browse every completed sale and cancel one if needed.
Service Orders: open an order for a customer, move it through open → inprogress
